ei.subject: 수능특강 영어
ei.title: The Crucial Role of Numbers in Football

fullPassage: Although many U.S. Americans consider mathematics boring and tedious, all forms of standardized rankings involve figures and numbers. When ranking quarterbacks, for instance, the NFL (National Football League) standardizes the ranking process by defining different numerical categories that cover all aspects of the position. Each quarterback has certain numbers and figures, ranging from "percentage of pass completions" to "interceptions over touchdowns" to "number of yards passed per game." The quarterback's livelihood depends on those numbers. To negotiate a raise, a quarterback has to improve his numbers, and when a quarterback is benched, it is often due to unsatisfactory numbers. Similarly, at least 13 million Americans belong to virtual football leagues in which participants select players from different professional teams; at the end of the season, the participant whose virtual team has amassed the most points, defined by each virtual league differently, wins the jackpot. Such leagues even have a draft at the beginning of the season.

The quarterback's livelihood (C)[contrasts / depends] on those numbers. Similarly, at least 13 million Americans belong to virtual football leagues in which participants select players from different professional teams; at the end of the season, the participant whose virtual team has amassed the most points, defined by each virtual league differently, wins the jackpot. det.analysis:

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: number(명사) → numerical(형용사). categories(명사)를 수식하므로 형용사 필요
det.tip: number(숫자, 명사) → numerical(수치의, 형용사)

questions.passage: Although many U.S. Americans consider mathematics boring and tedious, all forms of standardized rankings involve figures and numbers. When ranking quarterbacks, for instance, the NFL (National Football League) standardizes the ranking process by defining different numerical categories that cover all aspects of the position. Each quarterback has certain numbers and figures, ranging from "percentage of pass completions" to "interceptions over touchdowns" to "number of yards passed per game." The quarterback's livelihood depends on those numbers. To negotiate a raise, a quarterback has to improve his numbers, and when a quarterback is benched, it is often due to ____. Similarly, at least 13 million Americans belong to virtual football leagues in which participants select players from different professional teams; at the end of the season, the participant whose virtual team has amassed the most points, defined by each virtual league differently, wins the jackpot. Such leagues even have a draft at the beginning of the season.

det.korean: 쿼터백이 벤치에 앉는 것은 주로 불만족스러운 기록 때문이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① unsatisfactory numbers
❌ ② outstanding performance
❌ ③ personal preference
❌ ④ team celebrations
✅① unsatisfactory numbers: 원문과 일치
❌②: outstanding(뛰어난)이면 벤치에 앉지 않음
❌③: 개인 선호는 문맥과 무관
❌④: 팀 축하는 문맥과 무관
det.tip: benched(벤치에 앉음)의 이유 = unsatisfactory numbers(부진한 기록)
